snippet.title: Essentia: A monster catching adventure | Steam reveal trailer
snippet.description:
This was the trailer I prepared for the game's steam page. As you can tell by the date at the end (2025) it is from last year. Some things have changed since it was recorded, but it's still an accurate representation of what the game is like.

"Essentia: A monster catching adventure" is an indie RPG, that combines procedurally generated dungeon crawling and a unique turn based battle system with cute pixel art monster characters. The graphics are a combination of voxels, pixel art, and traditional 3d models with a pixel art shader. The story is pretty light and you can choose how much you want to engage with it.

I have been working on this project part time for about three and a half years, and my plan is to release it later this year (2026). I am a solo developer and all the design, code, graphics, and audio (except a few sound effects) were made from scratch. I have not used any AI on this project.

If this looks interesting, you can Wishlist the game on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3932560
